greeting: Fresh greens! Healthy eats! Feel the vitality!
Salad Sam! Nourishing bodies at high altitude!
Welcome! Like it FRESH? You've come to the RIGHT place!
GREEN means HEALTH! That's science! Probably!
Salads so fresh they were growing this morning! Literally!
Need vitamins? The sky is beautiful but my salads are NUTRITIOUS!
Step right up! Wholesome food for wholesome adventurers!
dialog.menu_offer: Today's bowls: Cloud-Kale Crunch! Sky-Spinach Supreme! And the famous Aether Avocado Array! Warning: may cause excessive health!
dialog.health_warning: How fresh? Day-old? Morning-picked? Or 'Still photosynthesizing on your plate?'
dialog.salad_philosophy: Salad is life! Greens are grace! Greasy food is... fine! But greens are BETTER!
haggle: Good health costs good coin! Worth it!
For a health-seeker? Ten percent off! And a free dressing!
Bulk salad? Family size? Twenty percent!
Fine! Extra croutons! But that's my final offer!
purchase_success: ONE FRESH BOWL! Coming up! Enjoy the vitality!
Excellent choice! Your body will thank you!
Dressing on the side! As requested!
purchase_fail: No coin? No salad! Seeds cost money!
Come back when you're ready to invest in yourself!
rumor: Red serves... chili. At altitude. Where it's already cold. Who wants to SWEAT?!
The conductor orders the Avocado Array. Good man. Healthy heart!
The sunandmoon once predicted 'growth from within.' I provide the nutrients!
Blue aeronaut tried my Cloud-Kale. Said it was 'uplifting.' Nice!
Something about the Vault makes all food taste like... nothing. Even my salads.
dialog.quest_hook: I need Cloud-Lettuce Seeds! The RAREST kind! From Verdant's floating gardens! Three seeds and I'll teach you my SECRET dressing recipe!
dialog.quest_active: Those Cloud-Lettuce Seeds sprouting in your pocket? I can sense them!
dialog.quest_complete: THE VITALITY! PERFECT! My secret recipe! 'Sam's Ascension Dressing!' Write it down!
dialog.quest_reward: Sam's Ascension Dressing Recipe - Ultimate health! Ultimate freshness!
farewell: Keep the greens growing! In your heart!
dialog.time_noon: Lunch rush! Fresh bowls! Happy healthy people!
dialog.time_night: Late night greens! For the health-conscious night owls!

party_reactions.korr: Nature's bounty. Fresh. As it should be.
party_reactions.renna: Nutritionally sound. But where is the protein?
party_reactions.suresh: Food that nourishes without excess. Balance on a plate.
party_reactions.sova: Practical food. Light. Good for staying alert.
party_reactions.grit: Salad? At altitude? Where it's cold? I want WARM food!
party_reactions.ashka: Where's the FIRE? Where's the SPICE? This is just... green.
party_reactions.senna: Perfect. Light on the stomach. Easy to run after eating.
party_reactions.callum: So green! So fresh! So... healthy!
party_reactions.petra: Earth provides. Good greens. Strong roots.

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time? Try the Avocado Array! Popular!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back for more greens? Building health!
relationship_dialog.friend: My health sibling! Ready for the FRESH stuff?
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Family! Salad family! Secret menu unlocked!
